name: VoiceAgentBench
primary_focus: End-to-end speech-based agents on realistic tool-driven tasks
evidence_notes: Public code and audio-backed data cover single, parallel, sequential, multi-turn, and safety tool-call subsets. Scoring emphasizes tool arguments and refusals rather than live spoken output or computer control.

name: EVA
primary_focus: End-to-end conversational voice-agent accuracy and experience
evidence_notes: Bot-to-bot evaluations cover complete multi-turn spoken conversations, enterprise scenarios, task accuracy, interaction experience, and voice perturbations.

name: VoiceAssistant-Eval
primary_focus: Listening, speaking, viewing, multi-turn behavior, and safety for general voice assistants
evidence_notes: A broad multimodal voice-assistant suite with public examples across listening, speaking, viewing, multi-turn interaction, and safety. It does not primarily evaluate tool execution or real-world task completion.

name: VoiceComputerBench / TalkAct
primary_focus: Real-time voice conversation while operating browser-based computer tasks
evidence_notes: VoiceComputerBench evaluates a simulated phone caller and an agent that talks while acting through Playwright on hermetic browser sites.

name: tau2-bench / tau-Voice
evidence_notes: The public framework covers tool use, dynamic user interaction, domain task success, and a full-duplex voice mode. It does not primarily evaluate general desktop or browser control.

name: OpenBench
primary_focus: Reproducible ASR, diarization, orchestration, and streaming-transcription benchmarks
evidence_notes: OpenBench measures speech infrastructure and model quality, including streaming and diarization. It is not an end-to-end agent task-completion benchmark.

name: mu-bench
evidence_notes: Public data focuses on real multilingual customer-service utterances and ASR provider evaluation rather than spoken agent action.

name: ELITR-Bench
primary_focus: Long-context LLM evaluation on meeting transcripts
evidence_notes: The benchmark evaluates long-context language-model behavior over meeting transcripts. It starts from text transcripts rather than measuring audio capture, ASR, or computer action.

name: Audio Agent Bench Suite
primary_focus: A collection of multi-turn spoken-agent benchmarks
evidence_notes: The public dataset card describes six spoken benchmarks spanning instruction following, knowledge grounding, function calls, memory, and state. At verification time the repository exposed the card but no substantive dataset files, so public_data is marked partial.
